title: Xpand IT is independent, custom-first and the right size, pending an open-source screen
content:
Xpand IT is independent, custom-first and at 370+ people the right size — three structural signals the screen looks for, all present at once. Independence means no group parent setting technology direction, and custom-first delivery means no product of its own sitting in the application-layer slot.

Its recorded stack is Atlassian, Microsoft and data tooling, and its open-source posture is unverified. The lead is therefore structurally qualified and technically unscreened, which is the same position as several of the strongest names in the set and the reason it sits at priority 3 rather than higher.
